# ipv6Pack() function

Compresses an IPv6 address: drops leading zeros from each group and collapses the longest run of zero groups to `::`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function ipv6Pack(ip: string): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

The compressed form, e.g. `2001:0db8:0000:0000:0000:0000:0000:0001` becomes `2001:db8::1`<!-- -->.

## Remarks

The inverse of [ipv6Unpack()](/api/net/latest/net.ipv6unpack/)<!-- -->, and what this package emits when producing IPv6 text. It is a string transformation with no validation, so a malformed input produces malformed output rather than an error.
